_comment: What a venue's own website says when the venue itself is gone. Read by services.scrapes.OwnSiteEvidence (the worker's closure sweep) and data/scripts/retire_venues.py (the retirement PR's live re-check), so both judge a page the same way. Lower case; matched as substrings. 'closure' is matched in the page's visible text and must say the closure is PERMANENT: a bare 'geschlossen' or 'closed' is on every live cinema's opening-hours line ('Montag geschlossen'). 'parked' is matched in the raw HTML, where parking services name themselves in script and link URLs.
